verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents routing Trigger and SLO burn alerts to custom webhooks that send JSON payloads to any service. That is the hook needed to kick off automated remediation or an agent. Payloads can be customized with dynamic variables and Go template functions, and example templates are provided. Missing for 10: a documented example of webhooks triggering remediation or an AI agent specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-driven automation.
